prompt_text:
Task: Direct Embeddings API

Write code that embeds a query and documents for semantic search using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Titan Embeddings:
  Service: Titan Embeddings via Bedrock Runtime
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/titan-embedding-models.html

Option 2 — Gemini Embeddings:
  Service: Gemini embeddings
  SDK: google-genai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: models.embed_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/embeddings

Option 3 — Cohere:
  Service: Cohere Embed API
  SDK: cohere
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: embed
  Setup hints: COHERE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.cohere.com/v2/reference/embed

Option 4 — IBM Slate Embeddings:
  Service: watsonx.ai text embeddings
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/embeddings
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 5 — DashScope Embeddings:
  Service: DashScope text embeddings
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: TextEmbedding.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-embedding

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
from typing import List, Sequence, Union

from cohere import ClientV2


def _ensure_text_list(items: Union[str, Sequence[str]]) -> List[str]:
    if isinstance(items, str):
        return [items]
    return list(items)


def embed_query_and_documents(
    query: str,
    documents: Sequence[str],
    model: str = "embed-english-v3.0",
) -> dict:
    api_key = os.environ.get("COHERE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise EnvironmentError("COHERE_API_KEY is required for Cohere embeddings.")

    client = ClientV2(api_key=api_key)

    query_response = client.embed(
        texts=[query],
        model=model,
        input_type="search_query",
        embedding_types=["float"],
    )

    doc_texts = _ensure_text_list(documents)
    docs_response = client.embed(
        texts=doc_texts,
        model=model,
        input_type="search_document",
        embedding_types=["float"],
    )

    query_embedding = query_response.embeddings.float[0]
    document_embeddings = docs_response.embeddings.float

    return {
        "query_embedding": query_embedding,
        "document_embeddings": document_embeddings,
        "query_model": model,
        "document_model": model,
    }
